items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was giving me a lot of uh record sessions... because of Mingus and Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: Such as getting into the recording. Ernie, you know Ernie Wilkins?

He was giving me a lot of uh record sessions, when I, I finally got enough money to, to purchase a home in Teaneck, New Jersey, because of Mingus and Ernie Wilkins. And during that we period recorded 1st Bassman. Ernie Wilkins wrote the music for uh the bassist um...Ray Brown.
